scope: metadata establishment only; no lexical ranking or semantic inference claim
baseline: historical count/chunk hash scans and Python SHA reconstructed with simplified document projection; legacy 10k admission cap omitted; not a byte-for-byte replay of the old complete snapshot

queries.legacy_counts: SELECT count(*) AS chunk_count,COALESCE(sum(octet_length(c.content)),0)::bigint AS content_bytes FROM workbench.chunks c JOIN workbench.source_versions v USING(workspace_id,source_id,version_id) WHERE c.workspace_id=%s AND v.status='active'
queries.legacy_chunks: SELECT c.chunk_id,c.source_id,c.version_id,c.title,c.page,encode(sha256(convert_to(c.content,'UTF8')),'hex') AS content_sha256,encode(sha256(convert_to(c.metadata::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS metadata_sha256,v.content_hash AS version_content_hash,encode(sha256(convert_to(v.metadata::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AS version_metadata_sha256 FROM workbench.chunks c JOIN workbench.source_versions v USING(workspace_id,source_id,version_id) WHERE c.workspace_id=%s AND v.status='active' ORDER BY c.chunk_id
queries.guarded_manifest: SELECT s.* FROM workbench.corpus_index_state s JOIN workbench.index_generations g USING(workspace_id,generation_id) WHERE s.workspace_id=%s AND s.status='ready' AND to_jsonb(s)=to_jsonb(g) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workbench.index_generations newer WHERE newer.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND newer.generation_id>s.generation_id) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='workbench' AND c.relname IN ('corpus_index_state','index_generations','corpus_source_state') AND c.relrowsecurity AND c.relforcerowsecurity)=3 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid IN ('workbench.sources'::regclass,'workbench.source_versions'::regclass,'workbench.chunks'::regclass,'workbench.workspaces'::regclass) AND t.tgname IN ('dirty_source_index','dirty_version_index','dirty_chunk_index','initialize_corpus_index') AND t.tgenabled IN ('O','A'))=4 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='workbench.index_generations'::regclass AND tgname='immutable_index_generation' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='workbench.corpus_index_state'::regclass AND tgname='corpus_generation_transition' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A'))
